title: Equality in the quadratic non-bent-component bound
summary: For every admissible dimension pair, decide whether a quadratic vectorial function attains the exact lower bound on nontrivial non-bent components.

formal_statement.body: Let $n$ be even with $n\le 2m-6$, and for a quadratic function $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^m$ let $N_F$ be the set of its nontrivial non-bent component functions. For every admissible pair $(n,m)$, determine whether there exists such an $F$ satisfying $|N_F|=2^{m-n/2}+2^{m-n/2-2}+2^{m-n/2-3}-1$. Construct an equality example or prove nonexistence for each pair.

scope.domain: Quadratic vectorial Boolean functions and non-bent components
assumptions: N_F is the set of nontrivial non-bent components
scope.unresolved_remainder: For every even n <= 2m - 6, an equality construction or a nonexistence theorem is still required for the exact Theorem III.7 value of |N_F|.
